name: Batu Kawan Berhad
summary: Batu Kawan Berhad, an investment holding company, cultivates and processes palm and rubber products in Malaysia, the Far East, the Middle East, South East Asia, Southern Asia, Europe, North and South America, Australia, Africa, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Plantation, Manufacturing, Property Development, and Investment Holding/Others.
